name: Diet
overview: Scripture reveals that God originally provided plants and fruits for human nourishment, emphasizing a diet rooted in His provision (Genesis 1:29). The Bible also warns against overindulgence, cautioning believers to avoid excessive drinking and gluttony (Proverbs 23:20; Ephesians 5:18). Additionally, Daniel's example highlights the value of disciplined, simple eating as a testimony of faithfulness (Daniel 1:12). Ultimately, the control of speech and desires, including those related to eating and drinking, is a matter for the believer to entrust to the Lord's guidance (Psalms 141:3).
